# fipe-data-pipeline

Bun 1.3.14 CLI for FIPE car prices (vehicle type 1), PostgreSQL, monthly publication,
optional AI segment labels, and S3-compatible backups.

Start with README.md. Product boundary: PRODUCT.md. Architecture and naming: docs/architecture.md.
Database adoption, Docker, retries and backups: docs/operations.md.

```sh
cp .env.example .env
bun install --frozen-lockfile
docker compose up -d --wait
bun run db:migrate
bun run crawl -- --brand 59 --year 2024 --month 6
bun run status -- --reference 328
bun run check
```

Commands: crawl, refresh [--backup], status, classify [--dry-run], backup, restore-drill.
Help/version need no credentials. Configuration is validated per command.
--model requires --brand; --reference conflicts with --year and --month.
--force resets only the selected scope. Resume failed crawls without --force.

crawl stores data without publishing. refresh publishes new months in order after backlog
and price-floor checks, then retries view updates and optional backups. latest_prices includes
only published references. A scoped crawl does not establish full reference coverage.

src/index.ts wires CLI commands; src/commands/ owns workflows; src/fipe/ owns HTTP and parsing;
src/classifier/ owns segment labels; src/db/ owns schema, connections and queries.
Use kebab-case files, camelCase functions, PascalCase types, and colocated *.test.ts unit tests.
Database scenarios live in tests/integration/; tests/fixtures/ contains frozen historical SQL.
Use drizzle/ migrations, not a second editable SQL schema. Back up and read the adoption notes
before migrating an existing database.

Vite+ provides formatting, lint, types and tests. bun run check requires Docker and uses only
disposable PostgreSQL databases. TEST_DATABASE_URL must end in _test; tests erase that database.
Never point it at production. See .env.example for operational configuration.
